title: Bat SVG Bundle, Christmas Bats with Santa Hat, Candy Cane, Holly Wreath & Bat Garland, Gothic Holiday Cut Files for Cricut (svg, dxf, png)
description:
Bats deserve a holiday too: six original Bat Christmas designs for crafters who like their Christmas a little gothic.

Each design is a single-layer, single-path cut file, so no slicing, welding or cleanup is needed. Cut them from glitter vinyl for mugs and tumblers, from cardstock for ornaments, cards and garlands, or use them on shirts, window clings and gift tags.

WHAT'S INCLUDED
• 6 designs: Bat Wing Tree, Santa Hat Bat, Candy Cane Bat, Bat Garland (repeatable strip), Holly Bat Wreath, Bat Wing Star (tree topper with slotted tab)
• SVG — Cricut Design Space, Silhouette Designer Edition, Inkscape, Illustrator
• DXF — Silhouette Studio Basic Edition, laser software
• PNG — 1800 × 1800 px, transparent background (6 in at 300 DPI)

SIZING TIP
Default size is 6 in on the longest side. For vinyl use 4 in or larger; for cardstock 5 in or larger. Cut several Bat Garland strips and line up the end stars for a longer garland.

LICENSE
Personal use, plus small-business use on up to 500 finished physical items per design. Please don't share or resell the digital files.

THIS IS A DIGITAL DOWNLOAD
No physical item will be shipped. Files are available right after purchase in a single ZIP.

Designed with the help of digital and AI tools, and checked by hand for clean cuts.
